rows.name: Popcorn Express
rows.notes: Facebook page (Honolulu, kettle corn since 1999) lists popcornexpresshawaii.com. The same website URL appears in directory listings. No Instagram handle found. No official schedule found. Directory street addresses conflict (Lawelawe St vs Kuwili St), so none recorded. Side set to town from the seed. Facebook page is undated, so activity not confirmed.

rows.name: Special Gifts by Clarice
rows.notes: Website URL appears only in third-party directory listings (Groupon, MapQuest). I did not open the site, and one other directory lists the website as N/A. Owner listed as Clarice Hamada (BBB profile). Directories disagree on address (820 6th Ave vs 3075 Kalihi St). No social accounts found. Side set to town from the seed.

rows.name: Sugar HI
rows.notes: Business name is Sugar HI Hawaii. Star-Advertiser (Oct 2024) gives the Instagram handle and says it popped up at the Plenty of Aloha farmers market at Windward Mall on Wednesdays and Sundays. That is a 2024 article, so current activity is unconfirmed. In-person ordering only per the article. No Facebook or website found. Schedule source not confirmed (likely the Instagram, but not verified).

rows.name: Sweet Treats by Kris
rows.notes: Active per Star-Advertiser (Apr 2026) and own website (pop-ups across Oʻahu, shipping). The Facebook page is titled 'Sweet Treats by Kris (Diamond Head)' and posts event schedules. The brick-and-mortar shop closed, and the business now does pop-ups. Listed as a vendor at the Plenty of Aloha Kaimuki and Windward Mall markets (plentyofaloha.com). Instagram handle not found. Side kept as windward per the seed because of the Windward Mall market, but the business is based in Honolulu/Aiea.

rows.name: Sweetened by Kristel
rows.notes: Listed on the Plenty of Aloha organizer page under both the Kaimuki Market and Windward Mall Market vendors. Also on the Shop Small Hawaii food list and a Taste of Kalihi Market vendor list (Aug, year unclear). No own website or social accounts found, so none given. The organizer page is undated.

rows.name: Tasty Jerky Hawaii
rows.notes: Own website and Facebook agree. Storefront at Mililani Shopping Center, 95-221 Kipapa Dr (side set to central). Honolulu Festival lists it as a 2025 and 2026 participant. The Facebook page posts market and mall pop-up dates (e.g. Pearlridge). No Instagram found.

rows.name: Ugly Stix
rows.notes: Facebook page (Honolulu) links to the Square store and posts craft-fair stops. The latest visible post was a Ka Makana Aliʻi event on May 10, which looks like 2025. Current activity not confirmed. Instagram handle not verified. Side left null because the location is unclear.

rows.name: Uncle T's
rows.notes: 'Uncle T's' appears in a vendor name list on the Plenty of Aloha homepage, which also has a Windward Mall market section. I could not tell which market it belongs to. No own accounts found. Search results for 'Uncle T's' returned unrelated businesses (Uncle Bobo's, Uncle's Ice Cream), and I did not tie any of them to this vendor.

rows.name: Wananao Coffee
rows.notes: Business spells it Wana'ao (also Wanaao). Own site sells 100% Kona coffee online and at a local farmers market, with a Honolulu address (424 Walina St). Hawaii Farm Bureau lists it at the Saturday Honolulu Farmers' Market (KCC), formerly Happy Cakes. The coffee is grown on the Big Island, and the seller is Oʻahu-based. Side set to town because the listed address and market are in urban Honolulu, although the seed said East Honolulu. No Instagram or Facebook found. Site and Farm Bureau pages are undated.

rows.name: XOXO Pastry
rows.notes: Own site: made-to-order desserts, minimum one day ahead. Marketspread vendor profile (Honolulu, HI 96813): https://marketspread.com/vendor/260790/xoxo-pastry/. A TikTok post tags @Xoxo.pastry with a Mililani location, but I did not confirm an Instagram handle. The Instagram result @xoxo_patisserie is a different business and was not used. Side left null because the seed said windward but sources show Honolulu and Mililani.

rows.name: Aloha Acai
rows.notes: Food truck run by sisters Uilani and Kehaulani Ho, opened Sept 2024 on Mehana St next to Windward Mall, Kāneʻohe (46-038 Kamehameha Hwy per a 2025 Star-Advertiser article). Star-Advertiser May 2026 confirms it is operating. The 2025 article gave Tue-Sat 11am-5pm. No own website or social handles found.

rows.name: Aloha Espresso
rows.notes: Coffee cart at 56-505 Kamehameha Hwy, Kahuku, next to the Giovanni's truck. Website URL comes only from a Yellow Pages listing and I did not open it. Some aggregator listings flag the business as closed or out of business, and I could not confirm status from an official source. No social accounts found.

rows.name: Aloha Mac Shack
rows.notes: Own website lists hours (Tue-Thu 2-9pm, Fri-Sat 12-10pm, Sun 5-9pm) and says it is at Ohana Hale Food Trucks, 1958 Kalākaua Ave, Waikīkī. It also says to find them on GrubHub, UberEats and DoorDash. Instagram handle taken from the Star-Advertiser (Nov 2024). One TikTok mentions a Monday Lewers St stop, which conflicts with the site, so check before relying on it. No Facebook found. Site is undated, so current status is unconfirmed.

rows.name: Aloha Shrimp
rows.notes: Family-run shrimp truck at 53-534 Kamehameha Hwy, Hauula. Only third-party sources found (a travel guide about 2.5 years old, MapQuest). No own website or social accounts found. Not the same as Giovanni's 'Aloha Shrimp' truck in Kahuku, which is a different business.
